title: New Customer Analytics Feature with EU User Tracking
description: The product team wants to launch a new analytics dashboard feature that tracks how customers use the platform. It will collect behavioral data (pages visited, features used, time spent) and use AI to generate usage insights and recommendations. The feature targets the EU market.
vendor_details: Using a US-based analytics processing vendor (MixPanel)

title: Email Marketing Campaign for US Expansion
description: Marketing wants to run a large email campaign to promote TechForward's new product tier to prospects in the United States, specifically targeting California-based tech companies. The campaign will use a new email marketing platform and include tracking pixels and personalization based on company data.

title: Internal HR Tool for Performance Reviews
description: HR wants to implement a new cloud-based tool for managing employee performance reviews, goal tracking, and 360-degree feedback. The tool will process employee names, roles, performance ratings, manager feedback, and peer feedback for all 200 employees in the Berlin office.

title: Public Website Redesign
description: The marketing team is redesigning TechForward's public website. The new site will include updated content, a blog, a resource library, contact forms, newsletter signup, and integrate Google Analytics, HubSpot tracking, LinkedIn Insight Tag, and a chatbot for visitor engagement.

title: Partner Integration with Financial Services Company
description: Business development is setting up a data integration partnership with a financial services company. TechForward will receive transaction data from the partner's customers (with consent) to provide analytics services. The partner is a regulated financial institution in the UK.
vendor_details: N/A — we are the vendor/processor in this relationship

title: AI-Powered Document Processing Tool
description: The product team wants to build a new AI-powered feature that automatically reads, classifies, and extracts key information from uploaded business documents (invoices, contracts, reports). The feature will use a third-party LLM API and will be available to all customers globally.
vendor_details: Third-party LLM API provider for document processing
estimated_value: Core product feature — significant revenue impact
